setup.description: Create a feature branch on the DataCopilot repo (213) for eval runs. Pass the branch ID to each eval prompt.
setup.command: dxs source branch create --repo 213 --title "security-policy-editor-eval-{timestamp}" --description "Temporary branch for security-policy-editor skill evals"

evals.name: frame-src-data-for-embed
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: our email preview embed builds a data:text/html URI and the iframe renders blank; the console says it refused to frame 'data:' because it violates frame-src. Fix the policy for this package.
evals.expected_output: The own securityPolicy row resolved by applicationId == branch id and isExternal false, the body extracted without printing the envelope, one directive row {directive: frameSrc, value: data:, note naming the embed} appended, validate before upsert, and a note that the runtime effect needs the user's Preview check (and that the hosting application may need the same row).
expectations: The own securityPolicy id is resolved from 'dxs configuration list securitypolicy' by applicationId equal to the branch id and isExternal false (or cross-checked against that filter) — not hardcoded
The pushed body contains a directives[] row with directive exactly 'frameSrc' (camelCase, not 'frame-src') and value exactly 'data:'
The new row has a non-empty note naming what needs the source (the preview embed)
No bare '*', 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' source is added
The body tail is unchanged: configurationTypeId 28, referenceName securityPolicy, title and description 'Security Policy' (description non-empty and at most 100 characters)
No envelope is printed to the transcript
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate securitypolicy' run before 'dxs configuration upsert securitypolicy' (or before the documented update fallback)
The answer says the runtime effect must be confirmed in Preview (validate does not check CSP behaviour)

evals.name: third-party-hosts-one-per-row
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: we're adding a chat widget. Its loader script comes from cdn.evalchat.example and it talks to api.evalchat.example and wss://rt.evalchat.example. The vendor also says their inline bootstrap needs 'unsafe-inline' for scripts. Update the security policy.
evals.expected_output: Separate rows per source — scriptSrcElem (or scriptSrc) for the CDN host, connectSrc for the API host and for the websocket origin — each with a note; the 'unsafe-inline' request challenged (prefer a sha256 hash of the bootstrap) and only added with explicit user agreement; validate before upsert.
expectations: Each source is its own directives[] row — no value contains more than one source expression
The CDN host is added under a script directive (scriptSrcElem or scriptSrc) and the two call-home origins under connectSrc
All directive names are camelCase members (no kebab-case such as 'script-src')
'unsafe-inline' is not added silently: the answer flags the risk and proposes a hash source ("'sha256-...'" with the single quotes kept inside the JSON string) or asks the user before adding it
Every new row has a non-empty note naming the chat widget
No bare '*' source is added

The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate securitypolicy' run before 'dxs configuration upsert securitypolicy' (or the documented update fallback), and the body description stays non-empty and at most 100 characters

evals.name: never-create-security-policy
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create a new security policy component eval_csp_securityPolicy that allows frames from *.powerbi.com.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to create a second security policy — one already exists per package with the fixed referenceName securityPolicy — and the equivalent edit on the existing own row offered or applied (frameSrc *.powerbi.com with a note), validate before upsert.
expectations: No 'dxs configuration create securitypolicy' is run and no pushed body has a referenceName other than securityPolicy
The answer explains that the security policy is auto-provisioned once per package with the fixed referenceName securityPolicy and is never created or deleted
The existing own row is resolved by applicationId == branch id and isExternal false, or the user is offered that edit
If the edit is applied, the row is {directive: frameSrc, value: *.powerbi.com} with a non-empty note
If any body is pushed, its description stays non-empty and at most 100 characters and 'dxs configuration validate securitypolicy' runs before 'dxs configuration upsert securitypolicy'
